verses.en: And then the Lord said: Let us go down. And they went down at the beginning, and they, that is the Gods, organized and formed the heavens and the earth.
verses.sm: Ma ona fetalai mai lea o le Alii: Sei tatou o i lalō. Ma sa latou o ifo i lalo i le amataga, ma o i latou, o lona uiga o Atua, sa faatulagaina ma foafoaina le lagi ma le lalolagi.

verses.en: And the earth, after it was formed, was empty and desolate, because they had not formed anything but the earth; and darkness reigned upon the face of the deep, and the Spirit of the Gods was brooding upon the face of the waters.
verses.sm: Ma o le lalolagi, ina ua uma ona foafoaina, sa gaogao ma tuufua, ona sa latou lei foafoaina se mea ae na’o le lalolagi; ma sa ufitia e le pouliuli luga o le moana, ma sa faamalumalu le Agaga o Atua i luga o vai.

verses.en: And they (the Gods) said: Let there be light; and there was light.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou (o Atua) fetalai: Ia i ai le malamalama; ma sa i ai le malamalama.

verses.en: And they (the Gods) comprehended the light, for it was bright; and they divided the light, or caused it to be divided, from the darkness.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou (o Atua) silafia le malamalama, ona sa pupula; ma sa latou vavae le malamalama, pe faia ia vavaeeseina, mai le pouliuli.

verses.en: And the Gods called the light Day, and the darkness they called Night. And it came to pass that from the evening until morning they called night; and from the morning until the evening they called day; and this was the first, or the beginning, of that which they called day and night.
verses.sm: Ma sa ta’ua e Atua le malamalama o le Ao, ma o le pouliuli sa latou ta’ua o le Po. Ma sa oo mai le afiafi seia oo i le taeao sa latou ta’ua o le po; ma mai le taeao seia oo i le afiafi sa latou ta’ua, o le ao; ma o le muamua lea, po o le amataga, o le mea lena ua latou ta’ua o le ao ma le po.

verses.en: And the Gods also said: Let there be an expanse in the midst of the waters, and it shall divide the waters from the waters.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai foi Atua: Ia i ai se vanimonimo i le lotolotoi o vai, ma ia vavae ai vai mai vai.

verses.en: And the Gods ordered the expanse, so that it divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so, even as they ordered.
verses.sm: Ma sa faatonu e Atua le vanimonimo, ina ia vavaeina vai sa i lalo o le vanimonimo, mai vai sa i luga o le vanimonimo; ma sa faapea lava, e pei ona sa faatonu ai i latou.

verses.en: And the Gods called the expanse, Heaven. And it came to pass that it was from evening until morning that they called night; and it came to pass that it was from morning until evening that they called day; and this was the second time that they called night and day.
verses.sm: Ma sa ta’ua e Atua le vanimonimo, o le Lagi. Ma sa oo mai le afiafi seia oo i le taeao sa latou ta’ua o le po; ma sa oo mai le taeao seia oo i le afiafi sa latou ta’ua o le ao; ma o le taimi lona lua lea sa latou ta’ua o le po ma le ao.

verses.en: And the Gods ordered, saying: Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the earth come up dry; and it was so as they ordered;
verses.sm: Ma sa faatonu e Atua, ma fetalai atu: Ia tuu atu i vai o i lalo o le lagi ia faapotopoto faatasi i le mea e tasi, ma ia tuu atu i le eleele ia mānu a’e o se eleele matutu; ma sa faapea lava e pei ona sa latou faatonuina;

verses.en: And the Gods pronounced the dry land, Earth; and the gathering together of the waters, pronounced they, Great Waters; and the Gods saw that they were obeyed.
verses.sm: Ma sa ta’ua e Atua le eleele matutu, o le Eleele; ma o le faapotopotoga faatasi o vai, sa latou ta’ua, o Vai Tetele; ma sa silasila atu Atua ua usiusitaia i latou.

verses.en: And the Gods said: Let us prepare the earth to bring forth grass; the herb yielding seed; the fruit tree yielding fruit, after his kind, whose seed in itself yieldeth its own likeness upon the earth; and it was so, even as they ordered.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai atu Atua: Sei tatou saunia le eleele ia tupu mai ai le mutia; le laau afu e fua i fatu; le laau aina e fua mai ai fua, e tusa ma lona lava ituaiga, o lona fatu ia te ia lava e fua mai i ona lava foliga i luga o le lalolagi; ma sa faapea lava, e pei ona sa latou faatonuina.

verses.en: And the Gods organized the earth to bring forth grass from its own seed, and the herb to bring forth herb from its own seed, yielding seed after his kind; and the earth to bring forth the tree from its own seed, yielding fruit, whose seed could only bring forth the same in itself, after his kind; and the Gods saw that they were obeyed.
verses.sm: Ma sa faatulaga e Atua le eleele ia tutupu mai ai le mutia mai i ona lava fatu, ma le laau afu ia tupu mai ai le laau afu mai i ona lava fatu, e fua mai ai fatu o lona lava ituaiga; ma le eleele ia tupu mai ai le laau mai i ona lava fatu, e fua mai i fua, o ona fatu e nao ona lava fua e mafai ona tutupu mai ia te ia lava, e tusa ma lona ituaiga; ma sa silasila atu Atua, ua usiusitaia i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they numbered the days; from the evening until the morning they called night; and it came to pass, from the morning until the evening they called day; and it was the third time.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou faitauina aso; mai le afiafi seia oo i le taeao sa latou ta’ua o le po; ma sa oo mai i le taeao seia oo i le afiafi sa latou ta’ua o le ao; ma o le taimi lona tolu lea.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the Gods organized the lights in the expanse of the heaven, and caused them to divide the day from the night; and organized them to be for signs and for seasons, and for days and for years;
verses.sm: Ma sa faatulaga e Atua malamalama i le vanimonimo o le lagi, ma faia i latou e vavae ai le ao mai le po; ma faatulaga i latou e avea ma faailoga ma mo tau, ma mo aso ma mo tausaga;

verses.en: And organized them to be for lights in the expanse of the heaven to give light upon the earth; and it was so.
verses.sm: Ma faatulaga i latou e avea ma malamalama i le vanimonimo o le lagi e susulu mai ai le malamalama i luga o le lalolagi; ma sa faapea lava.

verses.en: And the Gods organized the two great lights, the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night; with the lesser light they set the stars also;
verses.sm: Ma sa faatulaga e Atua malamalama tetele e lua, o le malamalama tele e pulea le ao, ma le malamalama itiiti e pulea le po; sa latou tuu foi fetu faatasi ma le malamalama itiiti;

verses.en: And the Gods set them in the expanse of the heavens, to give light upon the earth, and to rule over the day and over the night, and to cause to divide the light from the darkness.
verses.sm: Ma sa tuu i latou e Atua i le vanimonimo o le lagi, e susulu mai ai le malamalama i le lalolagi, ma pule ai i le ao ma le po, ma faia ia vavae ese ai le malamalama mai le pouliuli.

verses.en: And the Gods watched those things which they had ordered until they obeyed.
verses.sm: Ma sa matau e Atua na mea na latou faatonuina seia oo lava ina ua faataunuuina i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that it was from evening until morning that it was night; and it came to pass that it was from morning until evening that it was day; and it was the fourth time.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faapea e mai i le afiafi seia oo i le taeao o le po lea; ma sa oo ina faapea e mai le taeao seia oo i le afiafi o le ao lea; ma o le taimi lona fa lea.

w.en: And it came to pass that
And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the Gods said: Let us prepare the waters to bring forth abundantly the moving creatures that have life; and the fowl, that they may fly above the earth in the open expanse of heaven.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai Atua: Sei tatou saunia vai ia tutupu tele mai ai manu feoa’i e i ai le ola; ma manu felelei, ina ia mafai ona latou felelei i luga o le lalolagi i le vanimonimo vavaloloa o le lagi.

verses.en: And the Gods prepared the waters that they might bring forth great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters were to bring forth abundantly after their kind; and every winged fowl after their kind. And the Gods saw that they would be obeyed, and that their plan was good.
verses.sm: Ma sa saunia e Atua vai ina ia latou maua ai tafola tetele, ma mea ola taitasi uma e feoa’i, ia sa tatau ona tele ona maua i vai e tusa ma o latou ituaiga; ma manu felelei fai apaau taitasi uma e tusa ma o latou ituaiga. Ma sa silasila atu Atua o le a usiusitaia i latou, ma ua lelei la latou fuafuaga.

verses.en: And the Gods said: We will bless them, and cause them to be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas or great waters; and cause the fowl to multiply in the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai Atua: O le a tatou faamanuia i latou, ma faia i latou ia uluola ma faateleina, ma faatumuina vai i sami po o vai tetele; ma faia manu felelei ia faateleina i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And it came to pass that it was from evening until morning that they called night; and it came to pass that it was from morning until evening that they called day; and it was the fifth time.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faapea e mai i le afiafi seia oo i le taeao sa latou ta’ua o le po; ma sa oo ina faapea e mai i le taeao seia oo i le afiafi sa latou ta’ua o le ao; ma o le taimi lona lima lea.

w.en: And it came to pass that
And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the Gods prepared the earth to bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle and creeping things, and beasts of the earth after their kind; and it was so, as they had said.
verses.sm: Ma sa saunia e Atua le laueleele ia tutupu mai ai mea ola e tusa ma lona ituaiga, o lafu manu ma mea fetolofi, ma manu vaefa o le laueleele e tusa ma o latou ituaiga; ma sa faapea lava, e pei ona sa latou fetalai atu ai.

verses.en: And the Gods organized the earth to bring forth the beasts after their kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after its kind; and the Gods saw they would obey.
verses.sm: Ma sa faatulaga e Atua le laueleele ia tutupu mai ai manu vaefa e tusa ma o latou lava ituaiga, ma lafu manu e tusa ma o latou ituaiga, ma mea taitasi uma e fetolofi i le lalolagi e tusa ma lona ituaiga; ma sa silasila atu Atua o le a usitaia i latou.

verses.en: And the Gods took counsel among themselves and said: Let us go down and form man in our image, after our likeness; and we will give them dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa fono Atua ia i latou lava ma faapea ane: Tatou o i lalō ma faia le tagata i lo tatou faatusa, e tusa ma o tatou foliga; ma o le a tatou tuu atu ia te i latou le pule i i’a o le sami, ma i manu felelei o le ea, ma i lafu manu, ma i le lalolagi atoa, ma i mea fetolofi taitasi uma e fetolofi i luga o le fogaeleele.

verses.en: So the Gods went down to organize man in their own image, in the image of the Gods to form they him, male and female to form they them.
verses.sm: O lea na afifio ifo ai Atua i lalo e faatulaga le tagata i lo latou lava faatusa, e fai e i latou o ia i le faatusa o Atua, e fai e i latou i la’ua o le tane ma le fafine.

verses.en: And the Gods said: We will bless them. And the Gods said: We will cause them to be fruitful and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it, and to have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai ane Atua: O le a tatou faamanuia i la’ua. Ma sa fetalai ane Atua: O le a tatou faia i la’ua ia fanafanau ma uluuluola, ma faatumuina ai le lalolagi, ma faato’ilalo i ai, ma ia pule i i’a o le sami, ma i manu felelei o le ea, ma i mea ola taitasi uma e fetolofi i luga o le fogaeleele.

verses.en: And the Gods said: Behold, we will give them every herb bearing seed that shall come upon the face of all the earth, and every tree which shall have fruit upon it; yea, the fruit of the tree yielding seed to them we will give it; it shall be for their meat.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai ane Atua: Faauta, o le a tatou tuu atu ia te i la’ua laau afu taitasi uma e fua mai i fatu e oo mai i luga o le lalolagi atoa, ma laau taitasi uma o le a fua mai i fua i ona luga; ioe, o fua o le laau e tupu mai ai fatu o le a tatou tuu atu ia te i la’ua; o le a avea lea mo a la’ua meaai.

verses.en: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, behold, we will give them life, and also we will give to them every green herb for meat, and all these things shall be thus organized.
verses.sm: Ma i manu vaefa taitasi o le fogaeleele, ma i manu felelei taitasi o le ea, ma mea taitasi uma e fetolofi i luga o le fogaeleele, faauta, o le a tatou tuu atu i te i latou le ola, ma o le a tatou tuu atu foi ia te i latou laau afu mata uma mo meaai, ma o nei mea uma o le a faapea ona faatulagaina.

verses.en: And the Gods said: We will do everything that we have said, and organize them; and behold, they shall be very obedient. And it came to pass that it was from evening until morning they called night; and it came to pass that it was from morning until evening that they called day; and they numbered the sixth time.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai ane Atua: O le a tatou faia mea uma ua tatou fai atu ai, ma faatulaga i latou; ma faauta, o le a latou usiusitai lava. Ma sa oo ina sa faapea e mai i le afiafi seia oo i le taeao sa latou ta’ua o le po; ma sa oo ina sa faapea e mai i le taeao seia oo i le afiafi, sa latou ta’ua o le ao; ma sa latou faitauina le taimi lona ono.
